items.title: This helmet tells you when to turn ⮑
items.summary:
This motorcycle helmet puts GPS directions right in your field of vision, like something straight out of a video game!

#AI #futuretech
items.author: Matt Wolfe
items.transcript: So, this might be the coolest thing you see today. This motorcycle helmet puts your like GPS arrows right in your line of sight in front of you. It's called the Aegis Rider Vision, and they're saying this is actual footage that was shot through the helmet. So, here it is showing his speed and his next turn. And when he turns his head to look at the plane, it all stays down by the bike instead of moving with his head. They said that riders used to keep taking off the helmet when it had the heads up display that followed their eyes in their head. And when he's coming up on a turn, these yellow arrows show up right in his line of sight, so he can see exactly which corner he's supposed to take. And the camera in the chin, it actually doubles as a dash cam with about 20 hours of storage. And it doesn't matter what kind of bike you're riding. Now, the helmet does cost about two grand, but I know people with motorcycles who will spend like that much on their exhaust. But they are available for pre-order right now. The founder of this company actually got his PhD in self-driving cars, but he invented something for people that very much want to keep control of their vehicle instead of handing it off to an automation. So share this with a friend who loves motorcycles and would probably really dig something like
